findings.action: The unchanged PlanDigest does not establish an unchanged dependency commitment. reviewBundlePlanDigest (lines 1956-1970) hashes the review procedure and excludes the semantic scope, whose requirements and decisions are separately projected at lines 632-638. A dependency can change those requirements, obtain a new approved source review, and retain its plan digest and governing-contract IDs. externalDependencyStands accepts it, and manifestStandsOver replaces the sealed dependency with the current one, retaining the consumer's approval over a commitment its reviewer never assessed. Current trust and source approval establish current source acceptance, not compatibility with the consumer's reviewed commitment. Preserve and compare a semantic commitment digest that excludes operational follow-up dispositions, and add a regression covering changed requirements followed by source reapproval. This invalidates the same-commitment assumption behind D1; the existing passing synthetic tests do not exercise it.
